system.boundary: Build a physically causal four-cylinder in-line diesel fuel-injection system in Simscape Fluids.
engineering_objects: Build a physically causal four-cylinder in-line diesel fuel-injection system in Simscape Fluids.

FuelControl_m is a common mechanical metering command for the four pumping elements: changing it must alter delivered fuel through the physical pumping and spill paths rather than rescaling recorded signals.
All channels must come from the same physical simulation;
physical_paths: Feed all four elements from the lift-pump circuit, connect each element through its own high-pressure delivery path to a spring-loaded needle injector, and return spill and injector discharge flow to a common reservoir.

signs_and_coordinates: A common rotating camshaft must drive one low-pressure lift pump and four separately phased positive-displacement injection-pump elements.
The four cylinders must inject in the firing order 1-3-4-2.
injection_delivery has 4 channels in injector 1--4 order, each the injector volume flow in m^3/s.
feedback_and_control_causality: Build a physically causal four-cylinder in-line diesel fuel-injection system in Simscape Fluids.
The lift pump, plungers, delivery valves, compressible fuel paths, and injector needles must causally participate in those pulses.
